# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster can understand the nature, origin, and value of any 1 herb. If the
plant is not an herb, no information will be gained.
@@ 2
Allows caster to enhance the potency of any 1 growing herb by 100% (i.e., x2).
This spell may be used only once per herb.
@@ 3
Allows caster to locate any 1 specific variety of herb that is sought,
regardless of physical obstacles (gives exact direction, distance, and
quantity).
@@ 4
Allows caster to make any 1 herb capable of being instantly effective. When
the herb is subsequently used, its benefits/dangers will be immediately felt.
The herb will keep for 1 day per level of the caster.
@@ 5
Caster can double the potency of any 1 herb (growing or dead). This spell may
be employed only once per herb. May not be combined with Herb Enhancement.
@@ 6
As Herb Finding I, except that the range is 300'.
@@ 7
Caster can grow an herb by planting the proper seed. The herb is sterile and
the growth takes 1-10 rounds.
@@ 8
As Herb Mastery II, except potency is 3 times.
@@ 9
As Herb Finding I, except range is 500'.
@@ 10
Allows caster to remove any harmful poisons, by-products, or side effects from
all herbs within range.
@@ 11
As Herb Mastery II, except potency is 5x.
@@ 13
As Herb Finding I, except range is 1 mile. Location is known within 10'
radius.
@@ 15
As Herb Mastery II, except potency is 10x.
@@ 17
As Instant Herbal Cures, except herb will keep for 1 week per level of the
caster.
@@ 18
As Herb Finding I, except range is 5 miles. Location is known within 25'
radius.
@@ 20
As Herb Finding I, except range is 20 miles; location is known within 100'
radius.
@@ 25
As Enhancement, except that potency of 1 growing herb is increased 100% x
level of caster (e.g., a 30th level caster could increase the potency of a
growing herb by 3000% or 30 times its normal potency).
@@ 30
As Herb Mastery II, except that the potency fo 1 herb can be increased by 100%
x level of caster (e.g., a 50th level caster could increase the potency of any
herb by 5000% or 50 times its normal potency).
@@ 50
As Herb Finding I, except that caster can locate any 1 herb variety within a
range of 1 mile per level of caster (e.g., 50 miles for a 50th level caster).
Location is known within 100' radius.
